detail.longDescription:
PhotoRescue Launcher is an innovative home screen solution designed for users who prioritize data safety and efficiency. By integrating deep-scan recovery technology directly into your daily mobile experience, we ensure that your lost memories and important files are always within reach.

Why Choose PhotoRescue Launcher?
Lost an important photo? Deleted a video by mistake? Traditional recovery apps can be complex. PhotoRescue simplifies the process by providing a dedicated data management dashboard right on your home screen.

🚀 Powerful Recovery Core
Deep Photo Scan: Advanced algorithms to locate and restore deleted images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, etc.).

Video & Audio Retrieval: Bring back lost video memories and essential voice recordings effortlessly.

Document Protection: Securely scan for deleted PDFs, Word docs, and office files.

Non-Invasive Process: Professional-grade recovery that works locally without requiring Root access, keeping your device warranty safe.

📱 Next-Gen Launcher Features
Instant Recovery Access: One swipe from your home screen opens the recovery suite—no more digging through app drawers in a panic.

Dynamic Layout: A tool-centric design that prioritizes your most-used management features.

Privacy First: We value your trust. All scanning and restoration processes are performed entirely on-device. We never upload or share your private data.

📢 User Transparency & Guidelines
Launcher Integration: By setting PhotoRescue as your default launcher, your home screen layout will be optimized to provide instant access to recovery tools.

Flexibility: You can easily switch back to your original system launcher at any time through the app settings or system menu.

Disclaimer: While our technology is industry-leading, data recovery is not guaranteed for all files. Success depends on the file condition and whether the data has been overwritten.

How to Use:

Install PhotoRescue Launcher.

Follow the on-screen prompts to set as your default Home Screen.

Tap the " Scan" icon on your new desktop to begin recovering your lost files.

Download PhotoRescue Launcher today—the smartest way to organize your mobile life and protect your digital assets!
